intro:
# policy/index — where each fleet rule lives (v0, 2026-11-04)

Each rule area has one home, and this document only points to it. It never restates a rule. If the home and this index disagree, the home wins, and the index is out of date.
Kinds:
- `tool`: machine-enforced, in code or config.
- `method`: rstack.
- `repo`: AGENTS.md.
- `policy`: hk policy/*, operator-changeable.
- `decision`: hk decisions.

Editor: `operator` keys change only on an operator decision; `agent` keys may be edited by agents.

tail:
## Switches (location only; values live in the tool)
- mergewake acting | mergewake host config `daemon.act`
- mergewake reap acting | mergewake host config `reap.act`
- panewire quiet delivery | hub flag `--delivery-policy off`
- desktop idle shutdown | `policy/placement` (`idle_shutdown`) + node flag `--idle-shutdown`
- per-repo mergewake | `<repo>/.mergewake/policy.yaml` `enabled`

## Retired names (must not appear in any home except as history)
runtug, wrk, agent-skills, scopefuel (as quota tool), arbiter, admiral role docs (PLAYBOOK.md, CHECKER.md, SECRETARY.md, …), grok, kimi, pi-* profiles, handoff skill

## Machine block (v0 sketch)
```json
{"version": 0, "areas": [{"key": "merge-gate", "kind": "tool", "home": "mergewake:internal/pipeline/gate.go", "editor": "operator", "keywords": ["leak scan", "required_checks"], "claims": [{"id": "mergewake.gate.leak_scan", "said_in": "rstack:skills/wake/SKILL.md", "truth": "mergewake:internal/pipeline", "truth_regex": "(?i)leak"}]}], "retired": ["runtug", "wrk", "agent-skills"]}
```
- `policy/dots-on-hk` — what dots writes to hk and where; since 2026-11-12 also the common rules for mockup and asset requests (Canva source of truth and working mockups, files as hk attachments, adoption with `dots adopt`).
- `policy/observability` — Sentry and Grafana: the order of work (alert delivery and data loss before new coverage), who owns which configuration, where alerts go (Discord for the operator; lanes read Sentry and Grafana later instead of receiving events), what to connect next.
